apply_decorator_kv_transfer: apply the maybe_transfer_kv_layer decorator to wrap an attention layer function for KV cache transfer
check_kv_transfer_group: check if a KV transfer group is active and configured for v1 protocol
wait_for_kv_layer_load: wait for a KV cache layer to be loaded from a remote worker before attention computation
save_kv_cache_layer: save a KV cache layer to the connector after attention layer execution completes
resolve_layer_name: resolve an attention layer name to its canonical string identifier for KV transfer routing
